questions.question: The motion of the body moving along a circular path is an example of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is accelerated motion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The rate at which an **object's velocity** with respect to time changes is referred to as **acceleration in mechanics.**
 
• A body travelling in a circle at a constant speed is said to be moving at an **accelerated** **rate** since its motion is uniform in** speed but not in velocity**, which can be expressed in **magnitude** and **direction as a vector quantity.**
 
• The item is said to be **accelerating** when the **magnitude remains constant** but the direction shifts in a **circular motion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decelerated motion**

 
 
• ​A moving item might slow down or come to a stop as a result of **unbalanced forces**, reducing its speed. For instance, when a ball is thrown upward, it experiences both the upward applied force and the **downward gravitational force**.
 
 
 
• **Non-uniform motion**
 
 
• ​No matter how long the time intervals are, **non-uniform motion **refers to movement in which the item does not go the same lengths in the same amount of time. The motion of the body is regarded as **non-uniform motion** whenever the **velocity** of the moving object changes at a different pace, throughout the course of the same time interval.
 
 
 
• **Uniform motion**
 
 
• This kind of motion is described as the **movement** of an item that travels in a straight line and maintains a **constant speed** along that line while traversing equal distances in similar amounts of time, regardless of the length of the time. If a body is **moving rectilinearly** and the motion is steady, then the** body's acceleration** must be zero.

questions.question: Low annual range of temperature and high annual rainfall are characteristics of a _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is tropical humid climate.

__
 
• **Tropical humid regions have low yearly temperature variation and substantial annual rainfall.**
 
• The **climatic zone** known as the **humid tropics** is one in which **evapotranspiration** outpaces precipitation for at least 270 days out of every year and mean monthly **temperatures** are continuously high and exceed 18 C.
 
• The first of the five main climatic groups assigned the letter A in the** Köppen climate** classification is the **tropical climate**.

• **Hot, dry summers and warm, rainy winters are characteristics of the Mediterranean climate**. **Central California, Central Chile**, and the coasts of **South Eastern** and **South Western Australia** all have a **Mediterranean climate**. 
 
• In the summer, **subtropical** highs affect these locations, and in the winter, westerly winds. Hence, the region experiences hot, dry summers and warm, rainy winters.**​**
 
 
 
• **Temperate climate**
 
 
• The region of the globe between the middle **latitudes**, or 40 to 60 degrees north-south of the **Equator**, is known as the **temperate zone**. The areas of the **Earth** between the tropics and the poles are known as the** temperate zones.**
 
• The **temperate climate** is the one that prevails in this area. These places' average yearly **temperatures** show that they are **neither extremely hot nor extremely cold.**
 
 
 
• **Cold climate**
 
 
• **Cold climates** are one of the types of climates on our list that affect locations that man has not inhabited, and plant and animal species hardly survive. The **arctic** **environment** is the most **extreme subtype **and is **inhospitable** to all life except for a few species of lichens and moss.
 
• **Polar and highland climates** are two examples of **chilly climates.**
